topic: Number of countries with key economic and social rights for women

questions.question: Does every region has 'Equal right to start a business' the most in 2023?
Which right increased the most during 2000's?
required_interaction: See 'Absolute Change' column on every category
Employment discrimination based on gender prohibited - Yes (Count)
Law mandates equal pay for work of equal value for women and men - Yes (Count)
Paid leave of at least 14 weeks available to mothers (1=yes; 0=no) - Yes (Count)
There is legislation specifically addressing domestic violence - Yes (Count)
Women and men have the same rights to own property - Yes (Count)
Women can register a business on the same terms as men - Yes (Count)
answer: There is legislation specifically addressing domestic violence - Yes (Count)

questions.question: In 'Bar' view, what is the lowest value in 2020?
required_interaction: On year-slider, move the circle to 2020.
questions.answer: Equal right to start a business

questions.question: In Asia, what is the highest value in 2010?
questions.answer: Equal right to start a business

questions.question: In Oceania, which right was consistent?
questions.answer: Equal right to start a business
